capabilities: display folder context in Graph View and Local Graph labels
expand context automatically only for labels that still collide
configure path modes, separators, and label modes
include or exclude specific folder trees from labeling
preview generated labels live in settings
extras: Relies on an undocumented runtime adapter for Obsidian's internal graph renderer, so future Obsidian updates may require maintenance; README warns against developing or testing plugins in a main vault.
intentEvidence: makes repeated note names easier to read in Graph View and Local Graph by adding folder context to the displayed label
problem: Obsidian's graph view shows only the file basename, so notes with the same name in different folders display as indistinguishable labels.
summary: Graph label plugin that appends folder context to note names in Graph View and Local Graph so duplicate file names stay readable.
